research.summary: A public square turns beneath its pedestrians, leaving open who is guiding whom. Inspired by a study of folded contacts between migrating endothelial cells: BIN1 and SNX9 help coordinate cell polarity, and loss of SNX9 disrupts junction remodeling and directed migration in developing zebrafish vessels. Conceptual art, not a depiction of anatomy.
